weakness: No MFA on the portal administrator login or the freelancer's dashboard account
remediation_plan: Turn on MFA for the portal administrator and every dashboard account; turn on the dashboard's enforce-MFA setting; security keys for the portal, console, registrar, and dashboard
milestones: 2026-10-15 MFA on and tested; 2027-03-31 security keys in use
resources_required: Owner time (2 hours); two security keys about $100

weakness: Former contractor's account still active; no account review or removal step
source: P07 assessment (AC-02 objectives; new finding); P03 G-005, G-016
remediation_plan: Account disabled 2026-08-19; check the sites it could reach; monthly account review of every control plane tool (POL-01 7.4); removal the day an engagement ends
milestones: 2026-08-19 account disabled; 2026-10-01 first monthly review; 2026-10-31 removal step in the freelance addendum

weakness: Freelancer holds administrator rights over all 120 sites
remediation_plan: Limited role on assigned sites; no package upload or bulk actions; only the owner pushes to more than one site (POL-01 7.3)

weakness: Customer credentials in a spreadsheet and sent by email
source: P07 assessment (IA-05d., IA-05g., IA-05h.[01]); P03 G-007
remediation_plan: Shared password manager vault; rotate all 140 credentials; delete the spreadsheet and emailed copies; credential rules in the freelance addendum
milestones: 2026-10-31 vault in use and spreadsheet deleted; 2026-11-30 rotation complete
resources_required: Business password manager about $90 a year; owner time (8 hours)

weakness: Only one backup copy for 235 sites, held by the production provider; portal and DNS data not exported
source: P07 assessment (CP-09b., CP-09d.[01], CP-09d.[03]); P03 G-037
remediation_plan: Independent daily off-site backups for every site and mailbox (30 days); monthly DNS and portal exports; quarterly restore test of 3 sites
milestones: 2026-10-31 DNS and portal exports; 2026-12-31 independent backups for all sites; 2027-01-31 first quarterly restore test

weakness: No vendor list, security requirements, or vendor monitoring
source: P07 assessment (SA-09 objectives); P03 G-021, G-022
remediation_plan: Vendor list with data, location, and terms; annual review of the upstream SOC 2 report (done 2026-09-09); written data location confirmations from the dashboard and security vendors
milestones: 2026-09-09 upstream report reviewed; 2026-10-31 vendor list; 2026-12-31 vendor confirmations

remediation_plan: Weekly review on Mondays with a one-page checklist; new-device sign-in alerts; review weekly plus daily for 2 weeks after any incident; monthly log export
milestones: 2026-10-05 first weekly review; 2026-10-31 alerts on and export running

weakness: Hosting-only sites unpatched; bulk updates untested; no time frame
remediation_plan: Monthly vulnerability notices to hosting-only customers; free automatic security updates; one test site before bulk updates; 72-hour rule for critical updates; Terms of Service patching clause
milestones: 2026-10-31 test site and 72-hour rule; 2026-11-30 first monthly notices; 2026-12-31 Terms updated

weakness: AI triage dismisses findings with no human analysis; no sign-in monitoring
source: P07 assessment (SI-04 objectives); P03 G-014, G-024; P10
remediation_plan: Turn off auto-dismiss for protected categories; weekly review of dismissed findings; monthly sample of 50; sign-in alerts (POAM-007)

weakness: No incident reporting duty, contact list, or 10-day customer notice procedure
source: P07 assessment (IR-06 objectives); P03 G-031, G-033
remediation_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and notification matrix; collect a security contact for every customer; 24-hour reporting duty in the freelance addendum
milestones: 2026-09-28 runbook adopted; 2026-10-31 contacts collected; 2026-11-30 walkthrough with the consultant
